title: EWS Certificate - Maharashtra
eligibility: Must belong to General/Open category (not SC/ST/OBC/NT). Annual family income below Rs. 8 lakh. Family should not own more than 5 acres of agricultural land. Residential plot should not exceed 1,000 sq ft in notified municipalities or 200 sq yd in non-notified areas.
documents_needed: Income proof (Form 16 / salary slips / IT returns)
Self-declaration affidavit on Rs. 100 stamp paper (stating General category + income + asset details)
7/12 Utara (land record extract) — if agricultural land owned
Property documents / sale deed / tax receipt — for residential property
Domicile certificate or residence proof (ration card, Aadhaar with Maharashtra address)
Voter ID or other identity proof
step_by_step: Go to aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in and click 'New User? Register Here'
Register using Aadhaar OTP or manually with your details
Log in with username and password, select your district
Click 'Revenue Department' on left menu → 'Revenue Services'
Choose 'Income and Asset Certificate for EWS' from the list
Fill the application form with personal details, family income, and asset details
Upload all required documents (PDF/JPG/PNG within size limits)
Pay processing fee (Rs. 50 - Rs. 100 depending on district)
Submit and save the Application ID (acknowledgement number) for tracking
Tahsildar verifies via Revenue Inspector — takes up to 21 days
Once approved, download certificate PDF from the portal
where_to_apply: Online: Aaple Sarkar portal. Offline: Tehsildar office. Assisted: Maha e-Seva Kendra (CSC)
common_problems: Name mismatch with Aadhaar → get Aadhaar corrected first
Income proof rejected → get Form 16 from employer or proper IT return
Application showing no update after 15 days → visit Tehsildar office directly with acknowledgement
7/12 extract missing → get from Talathi office before applying
Mobile number not linked to Aadhaar → use manual registration instead of Aadhaar OTP
Photo too large → resize to under 20 KB using online tools
validity: 1 year (must renew annually; certificate issued after April 1 is valid for that financial year)
fees: Rs. 50 - Rs. 100 online; additional service charge at Maha e-Seva Kendra

title: Income Certificate - Maharashtra
eligibility: Any individual who is employed and a resident of Maharashtra. Used for scholarships, fee waivers, and other govt scheme eligibility proof.
documents_needed: Address proof (Ration card / Voter ID / Passport / Driving License / Electricity bill)
Income proof (Form 16 if salaried, IT return statement, salary slips)
Age proof (Birth certificate / School leaving certificate / PAN card)
step_by_step: Visit aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in and register as new user
Log in and select 'Income Certificate' from the main menu
Fill the application form with accurate personal and income details
Upload scanned copies of all required documents
Submit the application — you will receive an acknowledgement number
Track status using the acknowledgement number on the same portal
Certificate is issued within 15 days from date of application
Download the certificate once approved
where_to_apply: Online: Aaple Sarkar portal. Offline: Tehsildar office
common_problems: Income details don't match IT records → submit consistent figures across documents
Application rejected due to incomplete documents → check document checklist before submitting
Portal not accepting file → check file format (PDF/JPG/PNG) and size limits
Certificate not generated after 15 days → visit Tehsildar office with acknowledgement

title: Caste Certificate - Maharashtra
eligibility: Must be a resident of Maharashtra. Available for SC, ST, OBC, VJNT, SBC, NT categories. Proof of caste by birth required (father's caste certificate or community proof).
documents_needed: Domicile certificate or residence proof (ration card, electricity bill, voter ID)
School leaving certificate / birth certificate (for age proof)
Caste of parent (father's caste certificate if available)
Affidavit sworn before Executive Magistrate (if father's certificate not available)
step_by_step: Apply online at aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in
Register as new user (Aadhaar-based or manual)
Log in and select 'Revenue Department' → 'Caste Certificate'
Fill in personal details, caste/community details, and family information
Upload scanned copies of all required documents
Pay the applicable fee
Submit and note the application ID
Tahsildar verifies details through Revenue Inspector / Talathi
Verification includes local enquiry — may take 15-30 days
Download certificate from portal once issued
where_to_apply: Online: Aaple Sarkar. Offline: Tehsildar office. For validity verification: Caste Scrutiny Committee
common_problems: Caste not in Maharashtra government list → check state caste list before applying
Father's caste certificate not available → get sworn affidavit from Executive Magistrate
Name mismatch with school records → get school records corrected first
Verification delayed → follow up at Tehsildar office personally
Caste validity required separately for college admission → apply to Caste Scrutiny Committee after getting certificate
validity: Lifetime (but may need renewal for specific purposes like education)

title: MahaDBT Portal Registration & Application - Maharashtra Scholarships
eligibility: Must be a domicile of Maharashtra. Enrolled in a recognized educational institution in Maharashtra. Specific eligibility varies by scheme (SC/ST/OBC/EBC/Minority).
documents_needed: Caste certificate / validity (if applying under reserved category)
Previous year mark sheets / grade cards
Fee receipt / tuition fee paid proof
step_by_step: Go to mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in and click 'New Applicant Registration'
Authenticate using Aadhaar OTP (or biometric if mobile not linked)
Fill registration form — create username and password
Verify email and mobile via OTP
Log in with your new credentials
Complete your profile 100% (personal, contact, bank, education details)
Upload photo, signature, and required documents
Go to 'All Schemes' — portal shows schemes you're eligible for
Select the scholarship scheme you want to apply for
Fill the application form, upload scheme-specific documents
Verify all details and lock your application
Click 'Submit' — note the application reference number
common_problems: MahaDBT website not opening → clear browser cache or try in incognito mode; avoid peak hours (10 AM - 2 PM)
Forgot username → use 'Forgot Username' option; enter name + mobile + DOB to get username via SMS
Forgot password → use 'Forgot Password' option; get OTP on registered mobile/email
Aadhaar OTP not received → check if mobile is linked to Aadhaar; use biometric mode instead
Scheme not showing in dashboard → ensure profile is 100% complete; check scheme eligibility criteria
Application rejected → check reason on dashboard; re-apply with corrections during re-opening period (Aug-Sep)
Payment not reflecting → wait 24 hours; contact helpdesk with reference number
validity: Per academic year (renewal required each year)
fees: Free (no application fee on MahaDBT portal)

title: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh OBC Scholarship - Maharashtra
eligibility: Must be an OBC category student domiciled in Maharashtra. Enrolled in a recognized educational institution in Maharashtra (school / college / professional course). Family income below Rs. 8 lakh per annum. For hostel maintenance allowance: must be a hostel resident.
documents_needed: Hostel certificate (if applying for hostel allowance)
Non-creamy layer certificate (renewed for current year)
step_by_step: Register/Login at mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in
Complete your profile 100% (personal, education, bank details)
Go to 'All Schemes' and search for 'Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna'
Check eligibility — the portal will show if you qualify
Click 'Apply' and fill the scheme-specific form
Upload all required documents (caste, income, domicile, hostel certificate, fee receipt)
Verify all entered details carefully
Lock and submit the application
Note the application reference number for tracking
Track status in 'My Applied Schemes' — Under Scrutiny → Approved → Fund Disbursed
Scholarship amount is credited directly to your Aadhaar-linked bank account via DBT
common_problems: Non-creamy layer certificate expired → renew it before applying (available on parishisht.maharashtra.gov.in)
Bank account not Aadhaar-linked → get linking done at bank branch; scholarship will not be credited otherwise
Hostel certificate not from recognized hostel → get certificate from college-affiliated hostel only
Application under scrutiny for months → follow up with college administration to forward verification
Rejected due to income exceeding limit → check if income certificate shows correct figure; get corrected if needed
Renewal not reflecting → ensure previous year's course is marked 'Completed' in profile before applying renewal

title: Domicile Certificate - Maharashtra
eligibility: Must have resided in Maharashtra for at least 15 years (for standard domicile). Alternatively, 5+ years of residence with property or business proof. Children of Maharashtra government employees posted outside state are also eligible. Required for education quota, job reservation, and scholarship eligibility.
documents_needed: School leaving certificate / SSC mark sheet (showing school in Maharashtra for 7+ years)
Employer certificate (for govt employees posted outside Maharashtra)
step_by_step: Visit aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in and register/login
Select 'Revenue Department' → 'Domicile Certificate'
Fill the application form — personal details, residence history, reason for domicile
Upload scanned copies of supporting documents
Choose document delivery mode (digital download / post / collect from Tehsildar office)
Pay the processing fee (Rs. 50 - Rs. 100)
Submit application and save the acknowledgement number
Tahsildar's office verifies records — typically 7-15 days
Download certificate from portal once approved (or collect physically)
Domicile certificate is digitally signed with QR code for online verification
where_to_apply: Online: Aaple Sarkar portal. Offline: Tehsildar / SDM office
common_problems: Less than 15 years residence → apply under 5-year category if you have property/business proof
School records from another state → use ration card + voter ID as alternative proof
Aadhaar address not in Maharashtra → get Aadhaar address updated before applying
Application rejected due to insufficient proof → visit Tehsildar office to provide additional documents
Certificate not issued in time for admission deadline → get temporary residence certificate from Tehsildar first

title: Birth & Death Certificate - Maharashtra
eligibility: Birth registration: Must register within 21 days of birth at the local Registrar (Municipal Corporation / Gram Panchayat). Late registration allowed up to 1 year with affidavit; beyond 1 year requires SDM/Executive Magistrate order. Death registration: Must register within 21 days of death.
documents_needed: Hospital discharge certificate / birth notification (from hospital where birth occurred)
Aadhaar card of parent (for birth certificate)
Marriage certificate of parents (for birth certificate, if applicable)
Affidavit on stamp paper (for late registration — birth or death)
Death report / medical certificate of cause of death (for death certificate)
Identity proof of informant (person registering the death)
Hospital discharge summary (for death occurring at hospital)
step_by_step: For online application: Visit aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in → 'Health Department' → 'Birth & Death Certificate'
Select type: Birth Certificate or Death Certificate
Enter details: name, date, place of birth/death, parents' names, hospital details
Upload supporting documents (hospital notification, identity proof, etc.)
Pay the processing fee (Rs. 25 - Rs. 50 for normal registration)
Submit and receive acknowledgement number
Registrar verifies with hospital records — certificate issued within 7-10 days
Download digitally signed certificate from portal
For offline: Visit local Municipal Corporation / Gram Panchayat with all original documents
Certificate is also available at Common Service Centres (CSC) for assisted application
where_to_apply: Online: Aaple Sarkar portal. Offline: Municipal Corporation / Gram Panchayat / Registrar of Births & Deaths
common_problems: Birth not registered within 21 days → apply late registration with affidavit (up to 1 year); beyond 1 year → get order from SDM
Hospital records lost → get non-availability certificate from hospital + submit affidavit from parents
Name not decided at time of registration → register as 'Baby of [Father Name]'; name can be added later via Name Addition application
Death certificate shows wrong name → apply for correction with supporting documents
Certificate not downloadable → check if verification is complete; contact registrar if pending beyond 15 days
fees: Rs. 25 - Rs. 50 (normal); Rs. 100 - Rs. 200 (late registration with fine)

title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS) - Maharashtra
eligibility: Must be a student in class 8 in a government / aided / local body school in Maharashtra. Must have scored at least 55% (50% for SC/ST) in class 7 annual exam. Family income below Rs. 3.5 lakh per annum. Selected through a state-level exam (SAT + MAT). Only 2 students per school (one SC/ST) are recommended.
documents_needed: Caste certificate (if SC/ST/OBC — for reserved quota)
Bank account details of student (joint with parent)
step_by_step: School announces NMMS exam — register through your school (not directly online)
Fill the application form provided by the school — attach documents and photographs
School verifies eligibility and uploads application on NMMS portal (nmmsssat.maharashtra.gov.in)
School pays the application fee (Rs. 100 — SC/ST exempted) — collected from student or borne by school
Download hall ticket from school / portal 2 weeks before exam
Appear for the state-level exam: Mental Ability Test (MAT) + Scholastic Ability Test (SAT)
Results declared after 2-3 months — check on the NMMS portal
Selected students receive Rs. 12,000 per year (Rs. 1,000 per month) for classes 8 to 12
Scholarship amount credited via DBT to student's bank account
Renewal every year: must pass class 9, 10, 11 with minimum 55% (50% for SC/ST)
where_to_apply: Through your school (not individual online application); portal for school login: nmmsssat.maharashtra.gov.in
common_problems: School not aware of NMMS → inform the principal to register through DIET / SSA office
Missed the application deadline → check with DIET office if late applications are accepted (usually not)
Income proof above Rs. 3.5 lakh → get corrected income certificate from Tehsildar
Failed MAT/SAT → can apply again in class 8 if student is still in class 8 (only one attempt per student)
Scholarship amount not credited → ensure Aadhaar-linked bank account is correct in portal
Renewal rejected due to low marks → maintain 55% (50% for SC/ST) in annual exams for renewal
validity: Class 8 to class 12 (5 years, renewable annually based on academic performance)
fees: Application fee: Rs. 100 (SC/ST exempted). No renewal fee.

title: Caste Validity Certificate - Maharashtra
eligibility: Must already hold a caste certificate issued by Tehsildar. Required for: college admission under reserved category, government job appointment, and contesting elections. Verification is done by the Caste Scrutiny Committee of the respective division. Applicant must prove caste by birth — not by marriage or conversion.
documents_needed: School leaving certificate (showing caste from school records)
Parent's caste validity certificate (if available — strongest proof)
Affidavit on stamp paper sworn before Executive Magistrate
7/12 extract (for rural families — shows community in land records)
Voter ID of self and parents
step_by_step: Obtain your caste certificate from Tehsildar first (this is mandatory before applying for validity)
Visit the Caste Scrutiny Committee office of your division (Mumbai / Pune / Nagpur / Aurangabad / Amravati / Nashik)
Fill the application form (Form XVI for SC/ST; Form for OBC validity as applicable)
Attach all original documents — caste certificate, school records, parent's documents, affidavit
Submit the application in person or through authorized representative
Pay the processing fee (varies by committee — typically Rs. 100 - Rs. 500)
Committee issues an acknowledgement with a registration number
Verification officer conducts field enquiry — visits your native place to verify caste claims
Police verification may also be done for SC/ST claims
If satisfied, committee issues the Caste Validity Certificate within 3-6 months
If rejected, you can appeal to the State Level Scrutiny Committee within 60 days
where_to_apply: Caste Scrutiny Committee of respective division. Online: maharashtracsc.koha.gov.in (partial online submission available)
common_problems: Applying without caste certificate → get caste certificate from Tehsildar first; validity cannot be issued without it
School records show different caste → get school records corrected by proper authority before applying
Caste claimed through marriage → caste validity is based on birth, not marriage; cannot be changed by marriage
Parent's caste validity not available → submit parent's caste certificate + sworn affidavit as alternative
Field enquiry negative → provide additional proof (community certificates from village, land records, genealogical documents)
Validity delayed beyond 6 months → approach committee in person with acknowledgement number for status
Rejected validity → appeal to State Level Scrutiny Committee within 60 days with supporting evidence
validity: Lifetime (valid for life; accepted across all government bodies in Maharashtra)
fees: Rs. 100 - Rs. 500 (varies by division and category)
